newsitem.title: FRANCE: Canal Plus hopes for Kirch settlement.
newsitem.headline: Canal Plus hopes for Kirch settlement.

text.p: Canal Plus said on Wednesday it preferred a friendly settlement with Germany's Leo Kirch in the matter of the Premiere pay-television channel despite launching a civil suit "to protect our interests", a spokeswoman said.

Canal Plus and Bertelsmann have taken legal steps against Kirch because they believe the Bavarian media magnat's decision to broadcast first rate films on the DF-1 channel instead of on Premiere was hurting their interests.
Canal Plus, Bertelsmann and Kirch jointly own the Premiere pay-television channel.
Kirch has launched the DF-1 digital satellite television channel after a bitter dispute with Bertelsmann and Canal Plus which wanted to turn Premiere into a digital satellite television service.
In the end, Bertelsmann decided to drop its plans for satellite digital television in Germany.
